_comment: Exp 41b — RETURN TO FIRST PRINCIPLES (founder-directed 2026-05-22). Same frozen test article as Exp 41 (bench/dm/_convergence.py, the ConvergenceDetector), re-run under the restored simple convergence design. The hardened gamma gate (the 'unwieldy attachments') is stripped: convergence is decided by the original state gate — no new GENUINE discoveries for consecutive_rounds_required rounds (the top of the decay curve) — with gamma demoted to a pure diagnostic (never gates, never triggers). The specialist B-Cell verifier is promoted from shadow to LIVE for the software domain (code: LIVE_SPECIALIST_DOMAINS) so it filters noise, and novel_this_round is recomputed from the settled, verifier-filtered series (code: reference_runner_v2 round loop) so 'no new discoveries' means 'no new genuine discoveries that survived the verifier'. This is a controlled re-run: only the gate + verifier changed vs Exp 41; the target, panel, and all other knobs are identical, so a different outcome is attributable to the methodology fix, not a different target. It also double-confirms the maths model — reviewing the (validated) convergence detector should yield few/zero genuine defects and converge fast (~3–5 rounds).

_convergence_criteria.description: SIMPLE STATE GATE (hardened_gate_enabled=false; gamma diagnostic only). Converged iff the state gate passes for consecutive_rounds_required (2) consecutive rounds, where a round passes iff: no new GENUINE (verifier-filtered, settled) findings beyond max_novel_findings, open critical/high count not increasing over the stability window, no contested findings, not churning, and round >= earliest_stop_round. Gamma is computed and logged as a diagnostic but NEVER gates (gamma_alt_threshold=1.1 makes the gamma-alt limb unreachable; the run stays within the gamma telemetry-only window). This restores the founder's original definition: the top of the decay curve is the point at which no new genuine discoveries are being made; beyond that is noise or iteration. The specialist verifier (now LIVE for software) decides what counts as a genuine discovery.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: state gate passes for 2 consecutive rounds (no new verifier-filtered genuine findings; open-critical stable; not contested; not churning).
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds.

_methodology_changes_vs_exp41: (1) hardened_gate_enabled true->false: the F4+F6 conjunction gamma gate is removed; the original state gate governs. (2) gamma_alt_threshold 0.30->1.1: gamma can no longer trigger convergence either — it is purely diagnostic, both directions, per the founder's original design (gamma is the decay-curve descriptor, not the convergence threshold). (3) Verifier promoted: 'software' added to LIVE_SPECIALIST_DOMAINS so the B-Cell specialist (z3/mypy vs source AST) filters findings live instead of running in shadow. (4) novel_this_round recomputed from the settled verifier-filtered series before the gate check, so the gate counts genuine surviving discoveries, not raw registrations. max_rounds 20->12 keeps the run inside the gamma telemetry-only window and reflects the expectation of fast, honest convergence.
_plan_ref: Founder direction 2026-05-22: 'return to first principles — we built the wheel then added unwieldy attachments; clearly it didn't work.' See Experiment 41 Convergence Investigation notes (2026-05-22) for the full diagnosis the revised design responds to.
